description: This source file is a Java test class for the VertxBasedHttpProtocolAdapter, containing unit tests that evaluate its behavior in various scenarios such as authentication, telemetry and event message processing, and command responses.

classes.name: VertxBasedHttpProtocolAdapterTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that tests the behavior of VertxBasedHttpProtocolAdapter, including authentication, telemetry, event handling, command processing, and response scenarios.

methods.name: deployAdapter
methods.description: Prepares and deploys the Vertx-based adapter and initializes the WebClient for test requests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up mocks and fixture before each test case.

methods.name: finishTest
methods.description: Undeploys the verticle and closes Vertx instance after all tests.

methods.name: testPostTelemetryFailsForMissingBasicAuthHeader
methods.description: Tests that POST telemetry request without Authorization header fails with 401.

methods.name: testPostTelemetryFailsForInvalidCredentials
methods.description: Tests that POST telemetry request with invalid credentials fails with 401.

methods.name: testPostTelemetryFailsForUnreachableCredentialsService
methods.description: Tests that POST telemetry fails with 503 if credentials service is down.

methods.name: testPostTelemetrySucceedsForValidCredentials
methods.description: Tests that POST telemetry with valid credentials succeeds with 202.

methods.name: testPutTelemetrySucceedsForValidCredentials
methods.description: Tests that PUT telemetry with valid credentials succeeds with 202.

methods.name: testPostTelemetryFailsForNotSupportedQoSLevel
methods.description: Tests that POST telemetry with QoS level 2 fails with 400.

methods.name: testPostTelemetrySucceedsForQoS1
methods.description: Tests that POST telemetry with QoS level 1 succeeds with 202.

methods.name: testPutEventSucceedsForValidCredentials
methods.description: Tests successful PUT event request with valid credentials.

methods.name: testPostTelemetrySendsMessageDownstream
methods.description: Verifies telemetry message is sent downstream upon successful POST.

methods.name: testPostEventSendsMessageDownstream
methods.description: Verifies event message is sent downstream upon successful POST.

methods.name: testPostTelemetryWithTtdSucceedsWithCommandInResponse
methods.description: Verifies a command is included in the response when TTD parameter is used.

methods.name: testPostCmdResponseForInvalidCommandStatusIdResultsIn400
methods.description: Ensures 400 error for invalid command status.

methods.name: testPostCmdResponseForMissingCommandStatusIdResultsIn400
methods.description: Ensures 400 error when command status is missing.

methods.name: testPostCmdResponseForNotExistingCommandResponseLinkResultsIn503
methods.description: Ensures 503 if command response link does not exist.

methods.name: testPostCmdResponseForExistingCommandResponseLinkResultsInAccepted
methods.description: Ensures 202 when command response is successfully processed and delivery is settled.
